info.name: TheCocktailDB Search Cocktails by Name or First Letter

params.name: s
params.description: Cocktail name to search (e.g. margarita, mojito)

params.name: f
params.description: First letter to browse cocktails alphabetically (single letter a-z)

items.docs: Search for cocktails by name using the 's' parameter, or browse cocktails starting with a specific letter using the 'f' parameter. Use the 'i' parameter to search for an ingredient by name.
